DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
Veridist is a Python library for lifetime data and reliability analysis.
It fits Exponential, Weibull-minimum, Lognormal, Gamma, Normal and
right-Gumbel models, retains independent right-censored observations, and
reports standard errors, confidence intervals and B-lives.
It is source-available under BUSL-1.1 with an additional use grant for
non-commercial production use.
about.summary: Evidence-first distribution fitting with explicit execution contracts

tests.script: python -c "import veridist; assert veridist.__version__ == '${{ version }}'; print(veridist.cdf('gamma', 6.5, shape=5.0, scale=1.0))"

name: veridist
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "2.2.1"

package:
  name: veridist
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/v/veridist/veridist-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a549f779757d6bbc100705c96dfd102f1cab1090adf6ab01885196da0bae6659

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.26,<3

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - veridist
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - python -c "import veridist; assert veridist.__version__ == '${{ version }}'; print(veridist.cdf('gamma', 6.5, shape=5.0, scale=1.0))"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/alisadeghiaghili/veridist
  repository: https://github.com/alisadeghiaghili/veridist
  summary: Evidence-first distribution fitting with explicit execution contracts
  description: |
    Veridist is a Python library for lifetime data and reliability analysis.
    It fits Exponential, Weibull-minimum, Lognormal, Gamma, Normal and
    right-Gumbel models, retains independent right-censored observations, and
    reports standard errors, confidence intervals and B-lives.
    It is source-available under BUSL-1.1 with an additional use grant for
    non-commercial production use.
  license: BUSL-1.1
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - alisadeghiaghili
